name: Florence
pointBasis: Immutable WUP 2025 queue point copied unchanged in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment.
registryBasis: The official Comune di Firenze SIGS viewer exposes a Catasto group and a cadastral parcel layer. This evidences a local public map custodian, not citywide geometry extraction or cadastral title records.
blocker: The official viewer configuration and metadata were inspected, but the anonymous proxy/API requests did not return a usable bounded parcel feature response. No geometry sample is retained.

source.operator: Comune di Firenze (SIGS); cadastral metadata also references Agenzia delle Entrate
source.custodianScope: Municipal public map viewer for Florence; the RNDT metadata record identifies Agenzia delle Entrate as metadata/resource contact for national cadastral cartography.
source.crs: Viewer configuration exposes EPSG:3857/EPSG:900913 basemap and does not expose a usable parcel feature response in this attempt; no output CRS is asserted.

nativeFieldMapping.note: The viewer's getInfo configuration names FOGLIO and PARTICELLA as parcel attributes. No stable native composite identity was proven from a successful feature response, so none is retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official viewer HTML/JavaScript configuration inspection, RNDT metadata discovery, and bounded anonymous service/proxy attempts around the unchanged WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Florence municipal cadastral viewer route and parcel-layer configuration were verified; parcel geometry and citywide completeness were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: A proxy request failure, map extent/zoom behavior, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.

queries.query: Florence Italy official cadastral map parcels Comune di Firenze catasto map
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Comune di Firenze Catasto e urbanistica page, the SIGS official map viewer, the Comune geographic-data catalogue, and the RNDT metadata record for Cartografia catastale - Comune di FIRENZE.

queries.query: Firenze mappa catastale particelle servizio ufficiale Comune SIGS catasto
queries.result: La ricerca in italiano ha trovato il visualizzatore ufficiale SIGS del Comune di Firenze con il gruppo Catasto e il layer Cat. Particelle, oltre alla scheda RNDT della cartografia catastale del Comune di FIRENZE.

requests.assessment: Official viewer loaded. Its current inline configuration exposes the Catasto group and parcel layer catasto:Cat_ParticelleCatastali_CatastoTerreni, queryable=true, minZoom=16, and getInfo fieldNames FOGLIO/PARTICELLA.

Proxy returned a GeoServer ServiceException for missing request routing; no capabilities or schema response was obtained. The placeholder SERVER_R_I is viewer configuration, not a usable native endpoint by itself.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; TLS verification enabled; bounded bbox around the WUP point
requests.assessment: No usable map image/parcel feature response was obtained; the configured proxy route could not be resolved to a public service endpoint in this attempt.

RNDT metadata identifies Cartografia catastale - Comune di FIRENZE, responsible contact Agenzia delle Entrate, reviewed 2025-02-11, with RDN2008-6706 metadata CRS. This is metadata evidence, not a parcel geometry API response.

inspectedConfiguration.responseSchemaObserved: No parcel response schema observed; only viewer getInfo configuration was observed.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A real local cadastral viewer is evidenced, but public parcel geometry and stable native identity were not independently verified in this attempt.
